description: Start a full export of the organization's data: every matter with its documents and their complete version history, tasks, time entries, invoices and linked contacts, plus organization-wide contacts, clauses and templates, as ZIP parts of about 2 GB with a manifest listing every file and its SHA-256 checksum. The export runs as low-priority background work, so it can take a while for large organizations; poll data-exports.get for progress and an estimated time left, then use data-exports.download for links. One export runs per organization at a time: while one is queued or running, this returns that export instead of starting another. Download links are available for 7 days from the start of the export. Personal matters are not included. Organization owners and admins only.

versions.description: `all` includes every earlier version of every document; `current` only each document's current version.
